description: A number passes \(\operatorname{NamedForm}(n,e)\) exactly when it codes a scoped formula at size \(n\) whose free names represent auxiliary constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.named_recognition_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (n e : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedForm S n e = true ↔
    ∃ a, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a = e
